Text: This composite sample ballot shows ALL contests in this election that can be voted
on by voters registered in Orange County, Florida. The voter's actual ballot will only
have the contests that affect their precinct. This document is for reference only!
To vote, fill in the oval completely
next to your choice. Use a black ballpoint pen.
If you make a mistake, ask for a new ballot. Do not cross out or your vote may not count.
To vote for a write-in candidate, fill in the oval and print the name clearly on the blank line provided for the write-in candidate.
